versions.note: from tools/music_round5.py (written for Lyria 3 Pro); its length sentence dropped, since Lyria 2 makes about 33 s
versions.prompt: Lo-fi hip hop beat with a dusty soft drum loop and mellow electric piano chords, a little vinyl warmth, steady and unobtrusive, good for working. 80 BPM. Relaxed everyday background music for a slice-of-life video game, instrumental only, no vocals. Sparse, unhurried and easy to listen to for a long time. No strings section, no orchestra, nothing epic or dramatic, no big build-up or climax. No ending: it keeps the same calm level to the end so it can loop.
versions.use: Inside the office while Eric works.
